[SWS_CM_00250] Trigger SetReceiveHandler
⌈
The method SetRe-
ceiveHandler shall take as input parameter a pointer to the TriggerReceive-
Handler function.
ara::core::Result<void> Trigger::SetReceiveHandler(
ara::com::TriggerReceiveHandler handler);
The TriggerReceiveHandler constitutes a function without parameters and has
to use the GetNewTriggers method of the specific Trigger class to access the
retrieved trigger counter. See [SWS_CM_00351] for its definition.
